description: Phase 8 model: pretrained MobileNetV3-Small (ImageNet, frozen) image backbone with a LoRA low-rank adapter on the final conv, char-level text encoder (unchanged from tiny_multimodal), concatenation fusion, classification head. Replaces the from-scratch CNN in tiny_multimodal_v0/v1 with a real pretrained vision prior.
notes: Pretrained-transformer+LoRA text tower was attempted first and is NOT used: tracing a LoRA-adapted HuggingFace transformer (bert-tiny, then all-MiniLM-L6-v2) through coremltools 9.0 failed at the embeddings/position-id conversion step, reproduced with LoRA removed too (failure is in the base transformer's traced graph, not LoRA-specific). Fell back to the proven char-level text encoder per the roadmap's pre-registered fallback. LoRA (rank=8, alpha=16) is applied to the vision backbone's final 1x1 conv (96->576 channels) instead -- the one genuinely pretrained component in this architecture. Backbone otherwise entirely frozen (including BatchNorm running stats, held in eval mode during training).
